results.description: Returns the count of unique addresses with a non-zero balance of the given token at the latest indexed block. Counts addresses, not people: one person may hold from several wallets, and contract, burn and exchange addresses are included unless you exclude them.

excludeContracts.description: Leave out contract and burn addresses.
